configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the server name visible in the game browser

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required to connect to the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Administratorpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required for admin access to the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Command Password
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required by alternate syntax of "serverCommand" server-side scripting. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: RCON-Passwort
configurationFields.description: See the Security and Privacy menu for configurable options for the server's RCON

configurationFields.label: Server Admins
configurationFields.description: Sets the list of [Steam64 IDs](https://steamid.io/) for server admins. Format is "SteamID","SteamID"

configurationFields.label: MOTD
configurationFields.description: Sets the player welcome message (MOTD). Format is "Line1","Line 2"

configurationFields.label: MOTD Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the time interval between display of each line of the MOTD

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of clients (including headless clients) that may connect to the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Load Mods
configurationFields.description: Semi-colon separated list (moddir1;moddir2) of [mod directories]() to load (not server-side only mods). ONE LINE ONLY! Specify simply the mod ID or @modname (as applicable to the Updates settings) for any mods downloaded under Updates or the Store. Otherwise, use mod directory paths relative to the server base directory or full paths. Alternatively use the Startup Parameters File option

configurationFields.label: Load Server Mods
configurationFields.description: Semi-colon separated list (moddir1;moddir2) of [server-side only mod directories]() to load (the mods are not broadcast to clients). ONE LINE ONLY! Specify simply the mod ID or @modname (as applicable to the Updates settings) for any mods downloaded under Updates or the Store. Otherwise, use mod directory paths relative to the server base directory or full paths. Alternatively use the Startup Parameters File option

configurationFields.label: Client Mods
configurationFields.description: Semi-colon separated list (moddir1;moddir2) of [client-side only mod directories](). ONE LINE ONLY! These won't be loaded by the server, but will be used by the Manage Bikeys setting if enabled. Specify simply the mod ID or @modname (as applicable to the Updates settings) for any mods downloaded under Updates or the Store. Otherwise, use mod directory paths relative to the server base directory or full paths

configurationFields.label: Manage Bikeys
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the bikey files for each of the mods specified in Load Mods and Client Mods will be copied to the 'keys' directory on server start, to enable addon signature verification. All existing bikeys in that directory (other than the default 'a3.bikey') will be deleted

configurationFields.label: Server/RCON IP Binding
configurationFields.description: If required, you can change the binding of the server and BattlEye RCON by changing the Application IP Binding for this instance. NOTE: The IP must be reachable by GSCS, otherwise GSCS's console won't work

configurationFields.label: Disallow Duplicate Game IDs
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players with an ID that is identical to another player will be kicked

configurationFields.label: Addon Signature Verification
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players with unknown or unsigned mods will not be allowed to join

configurationFields.label: Allow Client File Patching
configurationFields.description: Specifies whether to prevent or allow file patching for clients

configurationFields.label: Client File Patching Exceptions
configurationFields.description: Sets a whitelist of [Steam64 IDs](https://steamid.io/) for clients allowed to use file patching. Format is "SteamID","SteamID"

configurationFields.label: Minimum Client Version
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum client version, below which clients won't be allowed to join. Default of 99999999 equates to the server version. NOTE: If the server uses the Performance Profiling Build in any way, set this to 0, otherwise no client can connect

configurationFields.label: Force LAN Mode
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will be forced into LAN mode - only local clients can connect

configurationFields.label: Headless Clients To Launch
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of headless clients to launch when the server starts. Further information on configuration is [here]()

configurationFields.label: Headless Clients Launch Time Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum time allowed for the server to successfully start, for any headless clients to be launched. If the server takes longer to start, the clients will not be launched

configurationFields.label: Headless Client IPs
configurationFields.description: Sets the IPs of headless clients able to connect to the server. Multiples connections and IPs are allowed. Format is "IP1","IP2"

configurationFields.label: Use Headless Client Startup Parameters File
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows the use of a [parameters file](https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/Startup_Parameters_Config_File) for additional startup parameters for headless clients. File is "hc_parameters.txt" in the server base directory. Useful if the server also uses its own Startup Parameters File for mods. Use with care

configurationFields.label: Local Headless Client IPs
configurationFields.description: Sets the IPs of those headless clients listed under Headless Client IPs that have unlimited bandwidth and nearly no latency. Format is "IP1","IP2"

configurationFields.label: FPS Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the limit for the server FPS. Setting this too high can have an effect on server performance

configurationFields.label: Enable UPnP
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will automatically create port mappings on UPnP/IGD enabled routers

configurationFields.label: Additional Server Startup Parameters
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional startup parameters that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Alternatively, use the Startup Parameters File option. Use with care

configurationFields.label: Use Server Startup Parameters File
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows the use of a [parameters file](https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/Startup_Parameters_Config_File) for additional startup parameters for the server. File is "parameters.txt" in the server base directory. Useful for long startup parameters such as -mod or -serverMod. Use with care

configurationFields.label: Skip Lobby
configurationFields.description: If enabled, joining players will skip role selection

configurationFields.label: Minimum Players For Mission Selection
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum number of players required before displaying the mission selection screen

configurationFields.label: Minimum Voting Threshold
configurationFields.description: Sets the fraction (0.00 to 1.00) of players needed to vote something into effect

configurationFields.label: Advanced Flight Model
configurationFields.description: Sets the Advanced Flight Model mode

configurationFields.label: Disable Voice Chat
configurationFields.description: If set, players will not be able to use in-game voice chat

configurationFields.label: Voice Chat Codec
configurationFields.description: Sets the voice chat codec type

configurationFields.label: Voice Chat Quality
configurationFields.description: Sets the voice sound range: 1-10 is 8kHz (narrowband), 11-20 is 16kHz (wideband), 21-30 is 32kHz (SPEEX) or 48kHz (OPUS) (ultrawideband)

configurationFields.label: Start Mission Immediately
configurationFields.description: If enabled, begins the mission immediately instead of waiting for players to join (autoInit). Requires Persistent Mission to be enabled

configurationFields.label: Persistent Mission
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the mission keeps running when all players disconnect. Required for "autoInit" (Start Mission Immediately option)

configurationFields.label: Enable Automatic Mission Selection
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server auto-starts the next mission in the mission cycle and waits for players in the role selection. Requires a [mission cycle](https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/Arma_3:_Server_Config_File#Mission_rotation) to be specified in AMP_server.cfg

configurationFields.label: Enable Random Mission Order
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server randomly chooses a mission from the mission cycle for starting or auto-starting. Requires a [mission cycle](https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/Arma_3:_Server_Config_File#Mission_rotation) to be specified in AMP_server.cfg

configurationFields.label: Enable Map Lines/Markers
configurationFields.description: If enabled, gives the ability to place markers and draw lines in map

configurationFields.label: Allow Profile Glasses
configurationFields.description: If disabled, glasses set in a player's profile will be ignored

configurationFields.label: Enforce Difficulty
configurationFields.description: Forces the selected difficulty on the server. To use custom difficulty settings, you must configure them in the profile within the A3Master directory

configurationFields.label: Enable Statistics
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will opt into [Arma 3 game analytics](https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/Arma_3:_Analytics)

configurationFields.label: Allowed File Extensions
configurationFields.description: Only allows files with the listed extensions to be loaded via the loadFile command

configurationFields.label: Allowed Preprocess File Extensions
configurationFields.description: Only allows files with the listed extensions to be loaded via the preprocessFile / preprocessFileLineNumbers commands

configurationFields.label: Allowed HTML Extensions
configurationFields.description: Only allows files and URLs with the listed extensions to be loaded via the htmlLoad command

configurationFields.label: Log Time Stamp Format
configurationFields.description: Sets the format of the time stamps used in the log file

configurationFields.label: Log Player Info
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server logs players' bandwidth and desync info every 60 seconds, as well as "network message is pending" owner identity

configurationFields.label: Run Script On User Connected
configurationFields.description: Sets [server side scripting](https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/ArmA:_Armed_Assault:_Server_Side_Scripting) to run when a user has connected

configurationFields.label: Run Script On User Disconnected
configurationFields.description: Sets [server side scripting](https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/ArmA:_Armed_Assault:_Server_Side_Scripting) to run when a user has disconnected

configurationFields.label: Run Script On Double ID Detected
configurationFields.description: Sets [server side scripting](https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/ArmA:_Armed_Assault:_Server_Side_Scripting) to run when a second user with the same ID is detected

configurationFields.label: Run Script On User Kicked
configurationFields.description: Sets [server side scripting](https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/ArmA:_Armed_Assault:_Server_Side_Scripting) to run when a user is kicked

configurationFields.label: Run Script On Unsigned Data
configurationFields.description: Sets [server side scripting](https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/ArmA:_Armed_Assault:_Server_Side_Scripting) to run when unsigned data is detected

configurationFields.label: Run Script On Hacked Data
configurationFields.description: Sets [server side scripting](https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/ArmA:_Armed_Assault:_Server_Side_Scripting) to run when a modification of a signed pbo is detected

configurationFields.label: Run Script On Different Data
configurationFields.description: Sets [server side scripting](https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/ArmA:_Armed_Assault:_Server_Side_Scripting) to run when a signed pbo is detected with a valid signature, but is a different version than a server has. Use with caution

configurationFields.label: Composition Script Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the composition script permission level

configurationFields.label: Steam Query Packet Size
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum Steam query packet size. Increasing this value can be dangerous

configurationFields.label: Call Extension Report Limit
configurationFields.description: If a server-initiated callExtension takes longer than the specified limit, a warning will be logged as well as reflected in the extension return result

configurationFields.label: Log Object Not Found
configurationFields.description: If enabled, "object not found" messages will be logged

configurationFields.label: Skip Description Parsing
configurationFields.description: If enabled, parsing of description.ext/mission.sqm will be skipped. Will show pbo filename instead of configured missionName

configurationFields.label: Ignore Mission Load Errors
configurationFields.description: If enabled, a mission will load regardless of the number of loading errors

configurationFields.label: Message Queue Size Threshold
configurationFields.description: If enabled, all of a player's message types and sizes are dumped to a logfile if #monitor is running and the player's Guaranteed Message Queue size goes above the set threshold

configurationFields.label: Disconnect Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets the server wait time before disconnecting a player after loss of an active traffic connection (if Kick On Disconnect Timeout is enabled)

configurationFields.label: Kick On Disconnect Timeout
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players hitting the disconnect timeout will be kicked, otherwise that will just be logged

configurationFields.label: Maximum Desync
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum desync value before the server kicks a player (if Kick On Maximum Desync is enabled)

configurationFields.label: Kick On Maximum Desync
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players hitting the maximum desync value will be kicked, otherwise that will just be logged

configurationFields.label: Maximum Ping
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum latency (ping) before the server kicks a player (if Kick On Maximum Ping is enabled)

configurationFields.label: Kick On Maximum Ping
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players hitting the maximum latency (ping) value will be kicked, otherwise that will just be logged

configurationFields.label: Maximum Packet Loss
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum packet loss before the server kicks a player (if Kick On Maximum Packet Loss is enabled)

configurationFields.label: Kick On Maximum Packet Loss
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players hitting the maximum packet loss value will be kicked, otherwise that will just be logged

configurationFields.label: Manual Kick Waittime
configurationFields.description: Sets the time interval before a player can return after a manual kick (such as vote kick, admin kick, bruteforce detection). -1 = until mission end, -2 = until server restart

configurationFields.label: Connectivity Kick Waittime
configurationFields.description: Sets the time interval before a player can return after a connectivity kick (ping, timeout, packetloss, desync). -1 = until mission end, -2 = until server restart

configurationFields.label: BattlEye Kick Waittime
configurationFields.description: Sets the time interval before a player can return after a BattlEye kick. -1 = until mission end, -2 = until server restart

configurationFields.label: Harmless Kick Waittime
configurationFields.description: Sets the time interval before a player can return after a harmless kick (such as wrong addons, Steam timeout or checks, signatures, content, etc). -1 = until mission end, -2 = until server restart

configurationFields.label: Voting Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets the time limit for voting. Format is <ready number>,<not ready number>

configurationFields.label: Role Selection Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets the time limit for role selection. Format is <ready number>,<not ready number>

configurationFields.label: Briefing Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets the time limit for briefing. Format is <ready number>,<not ready number>

configurationFields.label: Debriefing Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets the time limit for debriefing. Format is <ready number>,<not ready number>

configurationFields.label: Lobby Idle Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets the time limit for lobby idle

configurationFields.label: ArmaUnits Data Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets how long a player will wait for armaUnits data when connecting

configurationFields.label: Server Executable
configurationFields.description: Sets whether to run the 64 bit or 32 bit version of the server executable

configurationFields.label: Serverversion
configurationFields.description: Sets the [server branch](https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/Arma_3:_Steam_Branches#Arma_3_Server) (or branches) to install. Some require a Beta Password. NOTE: Update the server after switching branches, and set the Minimum Client Version to 0 if using the Performance Profiling Build in any way!

configurationFields.label: Enable Named Mod Directory Links
configurationFields.description: If set, mods downloaded under "Steam workshop items" will be linked to the server base directory in the format @modname, rather than just by reference to the mod ID. NOTE: Update the server after changing this setting

deploymentSteps.name: Basic Config File Download
Modscript Download
deploymentSteps.source:
#!/bin/bash

ModDirFormat="$1"

cd ./arma3/233780

workshopDir="./steamapps/workshop/content/107410"

if [ -d "$workshopDir" ]; then
  echo "Converting and linking mods"

  # Convert uppercase filenames to lowercase
  find "$workshopDir/" -depth -name "*[A-Z]*" -print0 | \
    xargs -0 -I {} bash -c "mv \"{}\" \"\$(echo \"{}\" | sed 's,\(.*\)\/\(.*\),\1\/\L\2,')\"" >/dev/null 2>&1

  find "$workshopDir" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d | while read -r modDir; do
    modName=""

    # Extract modName from meta.cpp
    metaCppPath="$modDir/meta.cpp"
    if [ -f "$metaCppPath" ]; then
      modName=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*name[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*"\([^"]\+\)".*/\1/p' "$metaCppPath")
    fi

    if [ -z "$modName" ]; then
      # Fallback: Try mod.cpp if meta.cpp does not contain a name
      modCppPath="$modDir/mod.cpp"
      if [ -f "$modCppPath" ]; then
        modName=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*name[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*"\([^"]\+\)".*/\1/p' "$modCppPath")
      fi

      if [ -z "$modName" ]; then
        # Final fallback: Try fetching name from Steam workshop webpage if no name found
        modID=$(basename "$modDir")
        modName=$(wget -qO- "https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=$modID" | \
          sed -n 's/.*<div class="workshopItemTitle">\([^<]*\)<\/div>.*/\1/p' | head -n 1)

        if [ -z "$modName" ]; then
          echo "Error: Unable to retrieve name for workshop item $modID. Skipping"
          continue
        fi
      fi
    fi

    # Sanitise modName
    modName=$(echo "$modName" | tr '/' '-' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//')

    if [ "$ModDirFormat" = "false" ]; then
      # Remove @name symlinks
      rm -f "./@$modName" >/dev/null 2>&1

      # Create numbered symlinks
      ln -sf "$modDir" ./
    else
      # Remove numbered symlinks
      rm -f "./$(basename "$modDir")" >/dev/null 2>&1

      # Create @name symlink
      ln -sfT "$modDir" "./@$modName"
    fi
  done
else
  echo "No mods to convert and link"
fi

exit 0

deploymentSteps.name: Headless Client Script Download
deploymentSteps.source:
#!/bin/bash

# Arguments: [number_clients] [server_binding] [server_port] "<server_password>" "<mod_list>" "<hc_parameters_file>" [start_limit]

netcommand="$(command -v "ss" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "ss" || echo "netstat")"

# Check if any headless clients are to be run
# If none, immediately exit
[[ $1 -eq 0 ]] && exit 0

# Check if server starts successfully within <start_limit> seconds
# If not, exit
server_started=false
startlimit=${7:-180}
for i in $(seq 1 $startlimit); do
  if $netcommand -uln | grep -q ":$3 "; then
    server_started=true
    break
  fi
  sleep 1
done
if ! $server_started; then
  exit 0
fi

# Start the headless clients
baseport=$(($3 + 498))
parfile="${6:-}"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$(dirname "$0")/arma3/linux64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
cd ./arma3/233780
for i in $(seq 1 "$1"); do
  if [[ "$2" == "0.0.0.0" ]]; then
    connect="127.0.0.1"
  else
    connect="$2"
  fi
  ./arma3server_x64 -client -nosound -profiles=A3Master -connect=$connect:$3 -port=$baseport -password="$4" "-mod=$5" "-par=$parfile" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
  clients+=($!)
done

# Monitor server process and terminate headless clients
# when server terminates or SIGTERM/SIGINT received
trap 'for client in "${clients[@]}"; do kill "$client" >/dev/null 2>&1; done; wait' SIGTERM SIGINT
while true; do
  if ! $netcommand -uln | grep -q ":$3 "; then
    for client in "${clients[@]}"; do
      kill "$client" >/dev/null 2>&1
    done
    wait
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 1
done
